title: UniformBlock v1 named uniform packing
summary: Adds a reusable explicit-schema UniformBlock for flat WGSL uniform field types (f32/vec2f/vec3f/vec4f/mat4x4f), replacing manual float-index packing with named setters and packed writes. Integrates UniformBlock in depth-to-texture scene uniforms and updates API docs/overview.
handoff_message: Antigravity review complete for "uniformblock". In Cursor, ask the agent to use get_feedback_for_cursor for "uniformblock".
cursor_notes: Implemented critical GC fix in UniformBlock.set() by removing Array.from(...).slice(...) and using zero-allocation paths (Float32Array subarray or indexed copy loop). Added requested read-only data getter (`get data()`), updated UniformBlock docs, and re-ran typecheck/build for belfast + depth-to-texture example.
